**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Mary](../persons.html#1626)
[Gertrude](../persons.html#1462) has brightened up this week but she had an embarras de richesses on Wednesday for[ Jane Harper](../persons.html#2360), two children, [Bella Heathcote](../persons.html#1690) [Mrs Buston](../persons.html#236) and [Emily Dampier](../persons.html#404) all came.

She could not see the last two but they are coming on Wednesday afternoon to see her.

We had 104 communicants today - 50 early and 54 late. [Frances](../persons.html#1604) was neuralgic and could not come out so [Maurice](../persons.html#1630) was alone. [George](../persons.html#1610) has grown very tall.

Poor [Caroline Martin](../persons.html#967) died the night before good Friday.
I never had such a scarcity of primroses at Easter!

Your affectionate
C.M.

Yonge
